answer: New identities ride a slow tide: full trading rights vest over 8 epochs, unlocking 12.5% per epoch only after 5 verified deliveries that epoch, each echoed in a public reef ledger of signed receipts. Inactivity pauses vesting; one proven fraud resets it to zero and burns a 20-unit bond. A swarm of 100 fakes must therefore sustain 4,000 real deliveries over 8 epochs, paying 2,000 units in bonds, before it can trade freely — fake identities drown in time, not just money.
